name: Entry Point Selector
teaser: Open a new window where you can choose where to spawn for each map
description_html:
Usage:

The SPT/user/mods/EntryPointSelector/client folder has EntryPointSelector.exe. It lets you choose the map and then entry points on that map.

Once you select an entry point of a map, you will keep spawn there when you raid on that map. Multiple entry points can be selected from which a random one will be chosen. A selected entry point can be unselected by clicking on it again

Client mod is optional

Options:

  • Only Once
    • If selected, after raiding a map, the selected entry points for that map are removed
    • If not selected, you will keep spawning on the selected entry points unless manually deselected
  • Auto Open
    • If selected, will open the exe itself once you choose a location
    • Opens on a second monitor if you have it. Otherwise, you won’t see the window because the game is running in fullscreen but it’s open behind the game.
    • If the client mod is installed (BepInEx folder in the zip), the exe automatically switches to the map you chose to raid in

Installation:

Extract into main SPT folder where Aki.Server is

Or copy only the mod folder from inside the zip to SPT/user/mods if you don’t want the client mod
